en: Colorized panoramic view over a small European town in a river valley. A river with a bridge runs on the left, red‑roofed houses and church towers fill the center, and steep hills with terraced slopes rise behind the town. On the right stands a round medieval tower on a wooded hill. The printed title at the top left reads "Camburg a. Saale." Additional small vertical text appears along the left and right borders.
